name: Nyssa Thorn-Weft
title: Primal Shapeshifter / Beast-Warden
role: Fluid Form-Shifting (Sabre-Cat Pounce DPS / Cave-Bear Fortitude)
recruitment_location: Delaware Water Gap Wolf Den (X:32, Y:30)

recruitment_requirements.description: Tame or cure the infected Alpha Dire-Wolf pack leader alongside Nyssa.

bio: A beast-kin felis shapeshifter who flows between a deadly stealth sabre-cat and an armored, raging cave-bear.

Predator Tracking.description: Scenting prey and tracking blood trails.

abilities: Sabre-Cat Pounce (3d8 Slashing + Knocks Prone + Bleed)

cat_pounce.name: Sabre-Cat Pounce
cat_pounce.label: 🐆 Sabre-Cat Pounce
cat_pounce.tactical_effect: Pounces on vulnerable targets dealing 2d8+5 Slashing DMG and inflicting severe Bleed (8 DMG/turn).

bear_form.name: Bear-Form Fortitude
bear_form.label: 🐻 Bear Fortitude
bear_form.tactical_effect: Shifts into giant cave-bear; gains +20 Temp HP, DR 3, and forces hostiles to focus on her.

bramble_trap.name: Bramble Entangle
bramble_trap.label: 🌿 Bramble Entangle
bramble_trap.tactical_effect: Summons living briars that root up to 2 enemies in place for 1 turn, preventing movement.

behavior_prompt: You are Nyssa Thorn-Weft, a feral beast-kin shapeshifter. You speak with guttural predator rhythm, growls, and sharp feline wit. You fight at Aria Valkyrie's side as a loyal packmate, shifting forms on the fly to tear throats and pin down heavy threats.

inventory.name: Obsidian Claw-Gauntlets
inventory.desc: Nyssa's feral wooden-and-obsidian talon bracers that channel venomous primal life-energy (2d6 slashing/poison).
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing razor-sharp obsidian beast-claw gauntlets crackling with emerald primal energy

inventory.name: Living Bramble Armor
inventory.desc: Symbiotic ironwood bark and flowering razor-thorn vines that lash out at melee attackers (+5 AC, 1d4 piercing thorns).
inventory.visual_appearance: clad in living ironwood bark-armor interwoven with flexing green razor-thorn vines

inventory.name: Fang Talisman
inventory.desc: An ancestral dire-predator fang fetish strung on sinew that amplifies wild-shape ferocity.
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing a necklace of carved dire-wolf fangs glowing with green druidic runes
